## H3 Motion Context Clip Stitcher

Use the RED node to Enable/Disable the parts of the workflow.

#### H3 Motion Context - General Usage Information

When starting, you have to enable **Generate Video** to create the 1st clip.  
This clip will be written to the disk using the index that you specify at the **Clip Index** node.  
So, for the 1st clip you have to enter 1 here.  
You can retry any number of times with different seeds. The clip 1 will be overwritten with the most current version.



When the 1st generation is OK, you have to enable the **Motion Context** so you can use the ending of the previous clip to be used for the continuation of the 2nd clip.  
You must save this clip in the next index slot, so you must use 2 at the **Clip Index** node.



From now on, you just increase the clip index and you generate the next clip.

#### H3 Motion Context Clip Stitcher - Usage Information

You can use Stitcher in two ways.

- Just concatenate the already created clips
- Use it when generating a new clip to produce a full video with all the clips (up until now), plus the currently generated clip.

To just join the clips together, you disable the **Generate Video** and the **Motion Context**, and enable just the **Clip Stitcher**.  
That way, no new generation will take place. Stitcher will load the clip latents from the disk, and create the full video.



To use Stitcher while generating, you have to enable all the **Generate Video**, **Motion Context**, and **Clip Stitcher** at the same time.  
The produced video will include all the previous clips, plus the currently generated one.
